vpnBandwidth.bypassed: {total} moved on a download client the bridge does not carry.
vpnBandwidth.empty: Nothing has been recorded yet. The figures start once a download moves.
vpnBandwidth.gap: Nothing left the tunnel, but the bridge was down for {duration} of this period.
vpnBandwidth.leaked: {total} of unprotected traffic moved while the bridge was not sealed.
vpnBandwidth.noBridge: No WireGuard bridge is configured, so none of this traffic went through a tunnel.
vpnBandwidth.noEngine: No download module is installed, so nothing is routing through the bridge to measure.
vpnBandwidth.sealed: The bridge held for the whole period, so every byte below went through the tunnel.
vpnBandwidth.title: Tunnel bandwidth
